release-bot: Opening deploy window for route-proxy v1.4.2. Feature-flag plan 'rp.v1.soft-open' 0% -> 2% -> 10% over 25m. Change window 02:30-04:30 UTC. Paging @anya @devin.

anya: ack. I'll monitor p50/p95, 5xx and routing success. runbook link posted to ticket.

devin: propose auto-pin if 5xx >1.5% sustained 3m OR p95 +250ms. pin-target v1.4.1. Also suggest starting at 1% not 2%.

release-bot: Plan updated: start 1% -> hold -> 2% -> 10%. Auto-pin rules enabled.

ops-bot: preflight OK. GPU headroom 30%, infra healthy. Alerts will page @devin on sustained errors.

anya: toggling to 1% now:
```
/redwood flag set rp.v1.soft-open --pct 1 --who anya --note "gentle start"
```

sam: running quick eval against saved prompts. will report semantic drift.

anya: metrics at 1% stable after 7m. advancing to 2% now.

ops-bot: at 03:12 observed error spike to 2.0% for 4m, paging @devin.

devin: investigating traces t-330 and t-335; looks like downstream cache write contention. Manual pin to v1.4.1 executed to stop ramp:
```
/release pin --service route-proxy --version v1.4.1 --who devin --reason "error spike during ramp"
```

release-bot: Manual pin recorded at 8623456835 by devin. Rolling cohorts back to v1.4.1 and draining v1.4.2 nodes. Posting short rollback note to #release-notes: "v1.4.2 soft-open halted due to elevated errors; pinned to v1.4.1 while infra investigates."

sam: filing bug with traces and sample inputs; assigning infra-cache team.

ops-bot: recommend hold on reattempt until fix + 24h staging soak.

anya: agreed. updating release ticket and closing loop. :white_check_mark:
